eligibility:

SaaS products Developer tools Hardware Indie projects

submit_steps: 1 Get a Steem account first There is no signup on Steemhunt itself. You register a Steem blockchain account elsewhere, which is its own process with its own key custody.
2 Sign in with a posting key /sign-in asks for a Steem username and posting key, stored in your browser until logout. No OAuth, no email link, no password-only option.

submit_requirements: A Steem account and its private posting key

rejection_reasons: Products already posted by another hunter Anything outside apps, software and gadgets
gotchas: Signing in means typing a Steem private posting key into a web form; there is no OAuth, no email link and no way to post without handing over the key.
The crypto reward is the entire pitch and it has collapsed: the site advertises a $1.44 average per hunt, and on the day I looked all 33 products of the day generated $0.02 between them.
Anyone can hunt any product, so a stranger may already have posted yours, written its description and taken the reward, and a duplicate cannot be posted over it.

source_lead: A juried design award at 65 euros a shot, scored by eighteen judges on design, usability, creativity and content, with no free lane at all.
eligibility:
You need 65 euros, or a 150 euro annual Pro membership A site that can survive a design jury: design is 40 percent of the score, usability 30, creativity 20 and content 10 An account You'll be rejected if A functional product with an ordinary site, which will be scored against the most ambitious work on the web and lose Anyone unwilling to pay, since there is no free submission route
Design work Marketing sites Web apps Design tools
youNeed: 65 euros, or a 150 euro annual Pro membership A site that can survive a design jury: design is 40 percent of the score, usability 30, creativity 20 and content 10 An account
submit_steps: 1 Decide whether the work can win Their published criteria are design 40 percent, usability 30, creativity 20 and content 10. This is a jury, not a directory, and the money is spent whatever the score.
2 Pick a lane and pay Standard Submission is 65 euros for one website. Pro at 150 euros a year includes one annual free submission and 30 percent off the rest.
3 Submit and wait for approval Submissions are approved before they are scored, and only approved sites go to the jury.

4 Sit through five days of voting An approved site goes to at least 18 jury members. The three scores furthest from the average are discarded automatically and voting runs five days, though a high jury score plus at least ten Pro users can produce a Site of the Day sooner.
submit_requirements: 65 euros per submission, or a 150 euro annual Pro membership
A live site, which is what is being judged
Credits for the people who made it, which is the currency of the community here
rejection_reasons: A functional product with an ordinary site, which will be scored against the most ambitious work on the web and lose Anyone unwilling to pay, since there is no free submission route
gotchas: There is no free submission of any kind. Every route to the jury is 65 euros a shot or a 150 euro annual membership, and the money buys a score rather than a listing.
Approval comes before scoring, so a submission can be rejected outright and never reach the jury at all.
The jury weighting is public and it is not about your product: design is 40 percent of the score and content is 10. A site that works well and looks ordinary is buying a low score.
The links are not all the same: the site name and the screenshot are dofollow, while the Visit Site button, the one a reader would actually click, is the single anchor carrying rel="nofollow".

faq.question: Does SaaS Scanner require a backlink to your site?
faq.answer: No, SaaS Scanner does not require a link back from your site.

faq.question: What gets you rejected from SaaS Scanner?
faq.answer: Nothing published about who is refused.
